title: Article 116 Article 116  Ratification is retroactive to the time of the conclusion of the contract unless a particular intention is manifested; provided, however, that this may not prejudice the rights of a third party.
statute_text:
Article 116 Article 116  Ratification is retroactive to the time of the conclusion of the contract unless a particular intention is manifested; provided, however, that this may not prejudice the rights of a third party.
(Liability of Unauthorized Agency)

variables.description: The act of confirming or approving an action previously taken.
A legally binding agreement between two or more parties.

predicates.description: The time at which the contract was concluded.
The ratification is retroactive to the time of the conclusion of the contract.
predicates.supporting_span: Ratification is retroactive to the time of the conclusion of the contract

rules.supporting_span: Ratification is retroactive to the time of the conclusion of the contract unless a particular intention is manifested; provided, however, that this may not prejudice the rights of a third party.
rules.explanation: Ratification of a contract is retroactively applied from the moment it was concluded, unless there's a specific intent otherwise or it harms a third party.
